hypothesis: A factual-only estimator explicitly conditioned on public action/context, actual selected fifth effect and estimated residual uncertainty will recover better return decisions than matched mean-only readout and the R30 ridge, while the same estimator with selected fifth observation erased loses the gain.

design.training_source: R29B independently generated synthetic FIT episodes only; one actually selected factual final return outcome per episode; no unselected return labels, no R29 DEV/OOD score feedback
design.fit_episode_structure: each group crosses context0/1, hidden sign +/- as generator-only, q magnitudes .75/1/1.15, selected fifth0/1, observed return0/1
observable_inputs: P80 normalized 16D factual return action key
P80 normalized 16D selected fifth action key
P80 factual selected fifth physical effect (zero-mask if missing)
design.state_decode: P80 action-key normalization, ratio feature1/feature0 inverse tanh with pinned STATE_SCALES[0]=2.4; context ratio feature2/feature0 inverse tanh with STATE_SCALES[1]=3.0; action ids from feature5/6
design.effect_decode: P80 observed-effect feature0 inverse tanh with scale 2.4; selected fifth actual effect is prior observed input; never apply oracle or unchosen future effect
design.fit_label: selected factual return physical displacement (decoded from original physical_target), NOT hidden q or hindsight value
design.estimator: fixed lambda=0.00001 closed-form float64 ridge, regularization all coefficients except intercept
design.uncertainty: estimate residual squared error separately for safe return, informative matching probe+return, and uncertain matching return with no informative fifth effect, from factual selected FIT rows only
design.score: preaction squared distance of predicted returned physical state to public goal, plus factual FIT residual variance if risk-aware; mean-only same coefficients with variance zero
controls: same model with selected fifth physical effect erased
R29 known-law analytic calibration is upper bound only
design.learning_budget: no new neural training; 3 closed-form fit sizes and one FIT-only validation; no match-capacity/neural convergence claim

comparison_rules.risk_aware_gain_over_mean_only_min: mean of all four prospective policy mean-regrets per panel; frozen before any implementation or result
comparison_rules.paired_group_bootstrap_lower: R30 ridge active-information per-group regret minus risk-aware active-information per-group regret, 12-group paired resampling; 2.5th percentile

interpretation.successful_baseline: conditional factual prediction and calibrated risk can solve this synthetic information-value task; NOT neural Hybrid improvement, unseen-mechanism generalization or evidence of novel intelligence
interpretation.failed_baseline: information/representation or outcome-risk model insufficient even with explicit factual feature prior; preserve negative and diagnose
interpretation.limits: closed-form convergence is independent only for this fixed linear estimator; GRU/SSM/neural convergence and matched FLOPs still unqualified
